title: Pin the classification profile digest in a short test so make gate catches it
description:
This is the second time in this epic that the per-tick integrated gate passed while CI on the epic branch went red on a shorttest.EndToEnd test (enb: cloud runner fixtures; now: the classification pin after a profile edit). The pin's only moving part from a profile edit is profile_digest. A short (non-EndToEnd) test that compares profileSetDigest of the embedded profiles against the pinned record's profile_digest would fail the gate at the tick that edits a profile, not hours later on the epic branch.
evidence: internal/reconcile/harness_test.go:1065 (newFixture calls shorttest.EndToEnd); internal/reconcile/reconcile.go:1613 (profileSetDigest)

ticfac run epic-43y filed this backlog tick from the finding c23a820dd7b23ed180f7e1170f73d65156afbe077625e45e76d05d036959c260 (reported by run-epic-43y/tick-o68/attempt-66): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-43y/absorptions/c23a820dd7b23ed180f7e1170f73d65156afbe077625e45e76d05d036959c260.json on the run branch.
